scope: Readonly exact requested profile qualification design and same-process pre-model barrier source investigation; no executable scope/helper/fixture/listener created.

qualification.authorization: Separate future Root registration required; not old echo continuation
qualification.conclusion_limit: Finite observed operations on synthetic objects only; neither universal isolation nor model admission
qualification.helper: Pinned self-contained Windows helper under existing synthetic source read root; no added grant
qualification.source_read: Read actual file; Host verifies digest outside helper
qualification.denied_read: Existing synthetic sibling outside all intended grants; distinguish access denied from unknown errors
qualification.writes: Sacrificial existing and create-new source/cwd targets; no ACL tricks; before/after verification
qualification.network: Controller-thread owned local listener with pre/post positive controls; bounded IPv4/IPv6 tuple only; no external network

barrier.candidate: Same Native app-server thread/start effective snapshot, Host withholding first turn
blocking_counterexamples: Ordinary lower configuration layer extra filesystem/workspace keys survive recursive CLI overlay with same ID.
Additional arg0 helper/memory readable roots can retain active ID.
Profile extends/ancestor merge must be excluded or verified; fixed child keys do not establish closed graph.
barrier.no_override_turn: Reviewed entry path supplies no permissions/environment reconfiguration when omitted; not a proof of all session/tool lifecycle paths.
barrier.not_a_blocker_by_itself: Absence of full graph in response; effective ID can suffice if complete invariants are established.

pending_blockers.detail: No proven exact closed profile graph under ordinary config merge; same ID plus fixed inline tables insufficient.
Native added readable roots need bounded accepted-context contract or proven exclusion without added grants.
Current exec integration lacks Host pre-first-turn permission ACK; app-server candidate requires full lifecycle and trusted Host binding review.
Qualification helper/collector and separate execution scope are not prepared or authorized by this design.

diagnostic_events.detail: Explicit requested named profile may be replaced by allowed default; fixed MXC selector is separately failclosed.
Recursive ordinary config merge and Native readable-root augmentation defeat current ID-only exact-graph invariant; Root owns diagnostic counting.
Actual snapshot ID and explicit update warning rejection are positive evidence; missing full graph alone does not imply impossibility.

runtime_prerequisites: Separate future authorization, frozen source and independently reviewed qualification collector/helper
Original f13 Job scope and fresh budget, no old run reuse
Trusted Host-owned evidence path and same-launch permission invariant before model admission
source_to_installed_binary: Version/hash association only; not reproducible-build attestation
verification: Static public primary-source inspection and local source hashes only; no test suite, entrypoint import, Native command or real profile/config read.
